task: OCR text -> ingredient list; dash-prefixed item per line, or exactly NONE
evaluation_notes: 10 text cases: three correlated OCR variants of one real packaging photo, two clean synthetic image fixtures, three synthetic extraction/robustness cases, two negative cases.

This is a diagnostic smoke benchmark, not a representative accuracy estimate or safety validation. Report real-photo results separately from synthetic and do not treat the three real variants as independent samples.

Required-ingredient matching should normalize case, accents, punctuation, organic asterisks, and whitespace. Use expected_aliases for French/English semantic equivalence. Match each canonical ingredient at most once.
optional_ingredients are neither required for recall nor false positives if returned. Other extra ingredients are false positives.
Preserve top-level ingredient boundaries and bracketed sublists. Report duplicate ingredients, order violations, and malformed output separately.
Do not use broad substring matching that confuses Cocoa with Cocoa butter or Soy lecithin with Soy protein concentrate.
evaluate_vision only identifies image cases. Text accuracy and direct-image accuracy are different tasks and should be reported separately.
The transcribed real-photo English list is in source_groups.current_packaging_photo.english_transcription; text cases retain actual OCR without fixing it in advance.
